scope.goal: Expose new backend capabilities in the existing legacy chat with compact status, slash replies, message actions and redacted result blocks.
non_goals: Do not redesign legacy chat or build new V2 windows.
Do not render raw private document text, chat ids, tokens, absolute host paths or provider outputs.
Do not execute live delivery, converter, Nextcloud write, deploy or host actions from this roadmap without a separate live-ready backend gate.
scope.ui_policy: Small legacy chat affordances only; full workbenches stay with the UI agent/V2.

slices.title: Secure mode chat indicator
slices.why_not_100: Backend route contract is ready; legacy chat indicator UI is not implemented in this backend-first slice.

slices.title: Attachment processing status
slices.why_not_100: Backend route contract is ready; attachment chip/footer UI wiring is not implemented in this backend-first slice.

slices.why_not_100: Backend ref resolver is ready; internal link rendering and modal/popover UI wiring are not implemented in this backend-first slice.

slices.title: Review and write gates
slices.why_not_100: Backend route contract is ready; compact inline action row UI wiring is not implemented in this backend-first slice.

slices.title: Task and reminder feedback
slices.why_not_100: Backend route contract is ready; slash command and task result block UI wiring are not implemented in this backend-first slice.

slices.title: File export intent preview
slices.why_not_100: Backend route contract is ready; attachment follow-up result block UI wiring is not implemented in this backend-first slice.

slices.title: MCP and system health quick status
requires: Read-only MCP, diagnostics, system health and version endpoints
slices.why_not_100: Compact slash summaries are not implemented yet.

requires: Project and sandbox actions classified as preview, gated mutation or live action
slices.why_not_100: Action safety classification is not yet surfaced to legacy chat.

slices.title: Diagnostics surfaces
slices.why_not_100: Compact redacted summaries are not implemented yet.

slices.title: Live delivery and converter affordances
slices.why_not_100: Live delivery/converter actions require separate action-specific readiness gates.

recommended_next: LC1: let the UI agent wire a compact legacy chat indicator against /api/security/dsgvo/status.
LC2: let the UI agent render /api/universal-inbox/items/{source_ref}/status in attachment chips/user footers.
LC3: let the UI agent route internal Memory/RaptorGraph links through /api/internal-refs/resolve.
LC4: let the UI agent render /api/review-gates/status as compact redacted action rows.
LC5: let the UI agent render /api/tasks/summary for compact reminder/task summaries.
LC6: let the UI agent render /api/universal-file-io/export-plan as an attachment follow-up preview.
LC7, LC8 or LC9: continue backend-first with compact read contracts where needed.
